captions.detailed: A bicycle crankset assembly featuring a central cylindrical black bottom-bracket shell, two light grey metallic crank arms, a large black circular chainring with circular cutouts, and two rectangular black platform pedals with orange reflectors. The crank arms are oriented 180 degrees apart, with the right arm integrated with the chainring assembly. The assembly articulates via a continuous revolute joint through the central spindle, while each pedal rotates independently on its stub axle relative to its crank arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a single-speed fixie crankset. It should include a central black bottom-bracket shell, two 180-degree opposed light grey alloy crank arms, a black circular track chainring with bolt holes, and two black flat platform pedals with small orange reflectors that spin on revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a bottom-bracket shell using a Cylinder primitive. Create a central spindle and attach two crank arms modeled by lofting or extruding profiles with tapered ends. Define a circular chainring using a thin Cylinder with subtracted circular holes, bolted to the right crank arm. Create the pedals by combining a Box for the platform body, a Cylinder for the spindle axle, and small colored boxes for the reflectors, then define continuous revolute joints connecting the spindle to the shell, and each pedal to its respective crank arm tip.
